installCommand: bash -lc 'curl -L https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.27.4-stable.tar.xz -o flutter.tar.xz && tar -xf flutter.tar.xz && export PATH="$PATH:$PWD/flutter/bin" && git config --global --add safe.directory "$PWD/flutter" && flutter --version && flutter pub get'
